minimal_separate_candidate: Keep the old post-exit branch and its full returned schema. Do not alter closure, ACK requirements, source/receiver checks, retry timing or mandatory complete drain.

Add a separate current-first-edge branch for the same admitted source tray/job/generation, current loaded tray at node=edge_from=0, exact committed_prefix [0], edge_to in {1,2}, and a finite non-Boolean edge_exit_at strictly greater than the actual fresh view.now. Require valid builtin identity types and the initial source prefix [0].
Return from=0, to=actual edge_to, observed_at=actual view.now, evidence=observed_entry_future_exit and the independent complete tray copy. Do not change raw view fields.
Use only the actual owner-A observe_protocol return from the accepted same session. A saved/supplied dictionary is a pure fixture and cannot authenticate this online proof.
entry_vs_reservation_proof: circulation_publish_event reserves the edge and assigns current edge fields before actual EdgeEnter. Those fields alone prove no entry.
circulation_edge_enter checks active leg, current internal traversal, from/to and not-yet-observed entry, then emits EDGE_ENTER.

The accepted binding emits edge_exit_at only after finding that tray's actual EDGE_ENTER receipt with the current INTERNAL traversal. It derives the exit from an already observed start plus public travel/minimum duration, without reading a future event.
Current public traversal_id is public_traversal_version and must not be equated to the private receipt traversal. No inverse floating subtraction is needed to manufacture entry_at.
required_pure_gate: Hash-bound saved actual first-edge positive and preservation of all old accepted post-exit outputs.
Clearly hypothetical reservation negative with the same current edge fields but no edge_exit_at; no fabricated saved-native reservation example.
Wrong owner/tray/job/generation, duplicate tray rows, changed prefix/source, unknown or Boolean/nonfinite exit time, and incomplete timestamp remain unclosed.
prefer_2 still needs the actual correctly queried updated ACK plus the actual hop; rejection/expiry/failure handling and final complete drain remain unchanged. Native-default never promises edge1.
Keep first-hop changes out of notification-gate tests and performance claims.
comparison_caveat: Earlier root closure also removes later root client.activate calls. Background demand IDs use len(client.roots), so the whole subsequent ID/tape stream can differ even if physical actions remain the same. This candidate cannot borrow the notification gate's identical-admission/ID claim. A separate version and declared comparison are required; no opaque-ID normalization or synthetic shadow admissions are proposed here.
cost_scope: All fresh reads, original validation/ACK/retry, actual drain, evidence construction, codec and caller return remain charged. An earlier logical closure is not itself a compute-time measurement or a 100ms certificate.
